item.tib: rgyal bstan gsal bar byed pa'i sgron mchog gsum sprul sku rnam bzhi gtsos drin chen bla ma'i tshogs la tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i thabs
item.coloph: 'di phyi'i skyabs mchog bla ma la/ 'di 'dra'i tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i thabs/ 'di ltar dgos zhes lha btsun pas/ 'di nyid byed po tshe snying po// skye bzhi 'khor mtshor bying pa la/ tshad med byang sems char chen gyis/ bdud bzhi'i tsha gdung rab bcom nas/ sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon par smon//
